name: electron-win-app
description: An Electron application with React and TypeScript
author: example.com

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.clean: npx shx rm -rf dist out addon/build .winapp && npm run clean-debug
scripts.build-all: npm run build-addon && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: electron-builder install-app-deps && winapp restore && winapp cert generate --if-exists skip && npm run build-addon && npm run setup-debug
scripts.package-msix: npm run build:unpack && winapp package ./dist/win-unpacked/ --output ./dist --cert ./devcert.pfx --manifest appxmanifest.xml
scripts.package-msix:arm64: npm run build:unpack:arm64 && winapp package ./dist/win-arm64-unpacked/ --output ./dist --cert ./devcert.pfx --manifest appxmanifest.xml
